name: AliMarko
title: AliMarko: a pipeline for virus sequence detection combining reference alignment and profile HMM search
description: Snakemake pipeline that filters host reads with Kraken2, maps deduplicated reads to a viral reference genome database with BWA, assembles unmapped reads with SPAdes, and screens contigs with profile HMMs, producing HTML reports with alignment, HMM match, and phylogenetic tree visualizations.
